about.title: About
about.intro1: I'm Ahmed Aboalayoun (fotedev), a Full-Stack AI Engineer based in Egypt, working in English and Arabic. I build web platforms, production RAG systems, and the automation and tooling around them.
about.intro2: I run my own work through a software factory: locked specs, vertical slices, CI-enforced gates and a measured run log. That is also why every claim on this site links to a dated source.
about.factoryBody: Milestones are gated: a spec is approved first, each slice passes lint, types, tests and a production build in CI, and results are recorded. If a claim cannot be verified, it does not ship.
about.arsenalAiItems: RAG pipelines, pgvector, embeddings, prompt engineering, MCP tooling, agentic workflows
about.arsenalFrontendItems: Next.js (App Router), React 19, TypeScript (strict), Tailwind CSS, RTL/i18n
about.arsenalBackendItems: Supabase, PostgreSQL, Row Level Security, Edge Functions, Zod
about.arsenalDevopsItems: GitHub Actions CI, Vercel, pnpm monorepos, deterministic release gates
about.ossBody: Contributions to NousResearch/hermes-agent (one merged via salvage with preserved authorship, two open) and a responsible security disclosure to MiniMax-AI, acknowledged by the vendor. Full details with dates below.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.introBody: This policy explains what happens to data on fotedev.me. It is written to be read, not to hide behind.
privacy.currentBody: Only what you type into the contact form yourself (see below). There are no analytics, no advertising trackers, and no cookies. The only other thing stored in your browser is a theme preference (light or dark) in localStorage, which never leaves your device.
privacy.hostingBody: The site is hosted on Vercel. As with any web host, Vercel processes standard request logs (IP address, user agent, requested URL) for security and operation. Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights are not enabled at this time; if that changes, this policy is updated first.
privacy.formBody: The form collects your name, email address, your message and optional service, budget and timeline choices, solely to reply to your inquiry. Submissions are checked by Cloudflare Turnstile (a privacy-friendly bot check) and rate-limited; for abuse protection we store only a salted, hashed fingerprint of your network — never your raw IP address. Inquiries are stored in a Supabase database in the EU (Frankfurt) region, with access restricted to me, and are deleted 24 months after the last message in a thread, or earlier on request.
privacy.deletionBody: You can ask me to delete your data at any time: email fote.engineer@gmail.com and I will delete the inquiry and confirm the deletion.
